description: Source code for HeadlessWindowCapturer class, handling video capture and frame processing in a headless Firefox environment.

classes.name: HeadlessWindowCapturer
classes.description: Class responsible for capturing and processing video frames from a headless widget.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a scoped reference to a VideoCaptureModuleEx object.

methods.name: RegisterCaptureDataCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for video frame data.

methods.name: DeRegisterCaptureDataCallback
methods.description: Deregisters a callback for video frame data.

methods.name: RegisterRawFrameCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for raw frame data.

methods.name: DeRegisterRawFrameCallback
methods.description: Deregisters a callback for raw frame data.

methods.name: NotifyFrameCaptured
methods.description: Notifies all registered callbacks of a captured frame.

methods.name: StopCaptureIfAllClientsClose
methods.description: Stops capture if no clients are registered.

methods.name: StartCapture
methods.description: Starts the capture process with specified capabilities.
